releaseNotes:
EAMAS v1.4.0 - Manual CRUD & AI-Free Sprints/Tasks Overhaul
- Added complete manual CRUD operations for Projects, Sprints, and Tasks.
- Removed AI-based automatic task generation, AI sprint planning, AI retrospective panels, and RAG configuration interfaces.
- Created premium TaskEditWindow.xaml modal dialog with dual-column inputs, calendar date pickers, and robust form validation.
- Integrated multiple intuitive triggers to open the Task Editor: top-toolbar + Add Task button, selected-task Edit Task sidebar button, and double-clicking Kanban task cards.
- Added a Delete Sprint button to return assigned tasks to the backlog and cleanly purge the sprint record from MongoDB.
- Implemented automated database synchronization to keep sprint TaskIds collections in sync with task updates, maintaining 100% schema integrity.
- Successfully built self-contained win-x64 executables and Inno Setup installers.
